exposure: Type of Cesarean Section (elective vs. emergency)
outcome: Frequency and types of distractions during Cesarean Sections
Impact of distractions on patient safety
Impact of distractions on theatre efficiency
cohort: 56 primiparous women undergoing uncomplicated elective (n=33) and emergency (n=23) Cesarean Sections
finding: While distractions during Cesarean Sections were frequent and prolonged procedure duration, they did not lead to observed perioperative complications in this cohort.
